title: Tree in the backyard bursts into flame

tellings.quote: Well, we had this tree that just spontaneously combusted in the backyard. It rained for two days.

plain: A tree in the backyard of a North Carolina man named Chris Bledsoe burst into flame on its own, even though it had been raining for two days. Bledsoe tells Michels this himself, as one of the strange events around his home, which he links to the UFOs he says are drawn to him.
